title: Hourly Rate vs Fixed Project Pricing
description: Compare hourly pricing and fixed project pricing to choose the best model for your freelance work.
content:
Hourly Pricing

Pros: Pay for actual time, safe for unclear scope
Cons: Clients may worry about hours, less efficient for fast work

Fixed Project Pricing

Pros: Predictable for clients, reward efficiency
Cons: Risk if scope grows, need accurate estimation

When to Use Which

  • Use hourly for ongoing work, debugging, or unclear scope
  • Use fixed price for well-defined projects with clear deliverables
